2025-08-18.text: Thank you and please confirm. Have a good evening!

2025-08-25.text: You may notice that the days looks very light on instructors. That is because very few of you can work this week. And I had to lock down most of Wednesday due to the lack of staff in addition to me flying to Louisiana that evening. That being said; I am always looking to add instructors. If you know anybody that would be interested let them know. This will be a very challenging semester and I hope that folks can work more than a couple of hours a week. Or at least have a couple days as available options. Special thanks to Shyla : she was able to come in Wednesday evening to help Eli . Otherwise I would have needed to cancel students from 6-8. Thank you and have a good evening.

2025-09-08.text: Please be prepared to show up on the day you are scheduled. I cannot afford to have any fewer instructors on any of the days this week. Otherwise I will need to start cancelling student sessions and that would not be good for the center at all because I would lose customers.

2025-09-15.text: Thank you and have a great evening

2025-09-22.text: Thank you and have a nice evening.

2025-09-29.text: Saturday hours may change during the week since this is the first week of a new month. Let me know if your availability for Saturday will stay open. I will try to give an update on Wednesday if I have new information for Saturday. Thank you.

2025-10-06.text: Saturday might fill up more by the end of the week. I will add folks if needed. Thank you.

2025-10-13.text: If anybody has availability on Tuesday from 4-6 and you are not working that day please let me know. It will be very tight for Eli and myself at that time (code for exceeding the student to instructor ratio). Thanks!

2025-10-20.text: Thank you and have a great evening.

2025-10-27.text: Hours on Saturday might vary; it is the first day of a new month. Currently there are 10 students scheduled at 1pm and not many earlier. Since this was the case I scheduled all of you from 10-2. I will keep those of you scheduled on Saturday posted if anything changes. Thank you.

2025-11-03.text: Strange hours, but it is the first week of the month and I believe there will be changes once parents realize it is a new month. I will keep you posted if I need additional help. Thank you.

2025-11-17.text: Thank you and have a good evening.

2025-12-01.text: Please be prepared to show up for your scheduled time. I am very light on employees this week. Thank you and have a good evening.

2025-12-08.text: Thank you for the great response! Thank you and have a great evening.

2025-12-15.text: Thank you and have a good evening. You guys are definitely challenging me with making the schedule. That being said. We will only be open on 12/22, 12/23, and 12/27 on the following week for Christmas. Please let me know your availability for those days. Eli will also be gone on that Monday and Tuesday.

2026-01-05.text: It is a quiet week so far. I believe that more parents will be scheduling as the week goes on. I will keep an eye on the schedule and add bodies as needed. Let me know if you will not be able to operate on a short notice. Thank you.

2026-01-12.text: A quick note; I send out the availability request for the coming week on Friday evening and I currently create the schedule on Sunday evening. I have mentioned this before and I am saying it again. If I do not get a response from you by 5:00 Sunday evening you will not get any hours for the coming week. Keep in mind that we are a team and if you do not respond to the Friday request it can have a negative impact on your teammates, myself, students, and parents. Additionally, it can possibly have an effect on your hours in the future. I hate to be this blunt and I hope that you understand where I am coming from.

2026-01-19.text: Saturday's schedule might improve. I will keep an eye on it during the week. Thank you.

2026-01-26.text: I appreciate that everybody got their information to me before 5pm tonight. Thank you and have a great night!

2026-02-02.text: Thank you for the responses. Just a heads up; Andrew will be on a very limited schedule due to classes at Elmhurst for the semester. I might reach out occasionally on days that are thin on staff. Have a great evening.

2026-02-09.text: Thank you and have a good evening.

2026-02-16.text: Thank you and have a good evening.

2026-02-23.text: I am very short-handed on Wednesday (2/25) and I need support for the 4-8 time period. Eli and I will not be able to take care of the students from 6-8 by ourselves as it will exceed the student to instructor ratio.

2026-03-09.text: Thank you and have a good evening!

2026-03-16.text: Thank you and have a good evening.

2026-03-23.text: It will be a ghost town most of this week due to Spring Break. Thank you for the prompt responses! Eli will not be back until April 13th; hopefully everybody will be able to step up and fill in the gaps where needed. I appreciate you all. Have a good evening!

2026-03-30.text: The schedule might change a little starting on Wednesday because it is the new month. I might need to add a couple of folks here and there.

2026-04-06.text: Thank you and have a good evening. I think parents are still figuring out it is a new month so there might be a few more students added to the schedule. I might be reaching out later this week for additional support if needed.

2026-04-13.text: Thank you and have a good evening

2026-04-20.text: I could use somebody to come in at 3:45 instead of 4:00 on Monday (4/20). And I could use somebody additional at 4-6 on Wednesday (4/22). Thank you and have a good evening.

2026-05-04.text: Thursday is still a problem. I hope that more folks can step up. Just let me know.

2026-05-11.text: Thank you and have a good evening.

2026-05-18.text: Thank you and have a good evening.

2026-05-25.text: Thank you and I hope you enjoyed your Memorial Day weekend.

2026-06-01.text: A rather odd week. As of tonight the schedule looks to be a ghost town. I am hoping that parents will remember that it is a new month and get their students scheduled.

2026-06-08.text: This week is family vacation week since classes ended for D25 last week. We have also lost 12-13 regular students to the summer. I expect numbers to pick up the following week. We had 11 assessments done this past week 7 of those students have signed up so far. I hope some those students will have sessions this week. That being said. I will be out of the center on 6/13 and 6/20, and possibly 6/17. Thanks all and have a good evening.

2026-06-15.text: Starting to get some of the summer kids attending. Should see the student numbers start to increase. Please let me know when any vacations are coming so I can plan accordingly. I will be gone from the center most of the latter half of July due to my son's wedding. And Eli will be gone a couple of days during that time as well. Thank you and have a good dayy.

2026-06-29.text: Thank you and have a good evening. Enjoy the 4th

2026-07-06.text: A little bump in the number of students this week. Keep in mind that the following week I will be gone from the center for my son's wedding and related travel starting on 7/16 and will not be back until 7/26. Additionally, Eli will be gone on 7/24. Andrew will definitely need support on Saturday, 7/24. Thank you and have a good evening.

2026-07-13.text: Thank you for the great responses. If you can please send me availability for the week of 7/20 - 7/25. Next weekend will be very full for me with the wedding and travel. I would like to get the schedule created before this coming Thursday. Thank you and have a good evening

2026-07-20.text: Keep in mind that I am gone this entire coming week. I hope the schedule does not change that much. Please send me msg's in Telegram if anything comes up. Thank you and have a good evening.
